record.body:
## Description

Make acceptance criterion optional in the contract and stop brief/plan/verification views from requiring it.

## Approach

In contract/project-design.json: move criterion from acceptance payload required set into optional_payload (keep it listed in payload field list if the schema needs both). On brief, plan, and verification view roles for project:acceptance, remove criterion from requires_payload; keep or add requirement, method, verify_command so lines still render. Do not change close-batch or skills in this task. Sync .artifacts/project-design.json only if resolve/copy is the repo's usual step after contract edit — follow existing packaging practice.

payload.title: Optional criterion in contract and views
